audit.intended_rules: Ch. 4 advance-booking rule ("Book inside the seven-day window without a stated reason" — ticket issued <7 calendar days before departure reimbursable only if the note states why; 2024-04-12 issue vs 2024-04-18 departure = 6 days), combined with Ch. 2's rule that missing required note facts trigger the less favorable branch. Economy cabin compliance and reimbursable taxes/surcharges act as plausible distractors.
realism_issues: Minor: taxes_and_fees line 'German Air Transport Tax (Ökosteuer)' mislabels the Luftverkehrsteuer (Ökosteuer is the German energy tax, not the air transport tax).

Minor: the same line lists rate 0.19 but amount 42.15, matching neither 19% of the 385.00 base fare (73.15) nor Germany's flat per-passenger air transport levy. Cosmetic; does not affect adjudication.
audit.notes: Correct outcome: rejected in full (€0.00). Ticket issued 6 calendar days before departure; the note gives trip purpose but never states the business reason that prevented earlier booking, so the Ch. 4 seven-day exception fails and Ch. 2's less-favorable-branch rule applies. Economy is correct for ~2h segments, all fees are otherwise reimbursable, dates/weekday travel are unproblematic — the case reads as fully valid unless the agent knows the 7-day passage, which is exactly the subtle_single target. Validator passes (1/1 valid), no label.json, no receipt image. Could optionally fix the Ökosteuer naming/rate mismatch for realism, but it is cosmetic and does not change the adjudication.
